resources.string: Collecting the bug report. This takes a minute or two. You can describe the problem below while you wait.
Sent to ZeroS, and deleted from this phone.
Report ID: %1$s\nQuote this ID if you open an issue on GitHub or ask for the report to be deleted.
No bug report is waiting. To collect one, tap Bug report in quick settings.
The bug report could not be collected. Try again in a minute.
You didn\'t allow ZeroS tools to use the bug report, so it was deleted.
Another bug report is still being collected. Try again in a few minutes.
What were you doing, and what happened?

A bug report contains this phone\'s system logs and settings, the list of installed apps and other details about the phone. It can include personal information, such as account names and Wi-Fi network names. ZeroS keeps the reports it receives for 30 days, and only the ZeroS developer can read them.
The report wasn\'t sent. Check the connection and try again.
ZeroS is getting too many reports right now. Try again later, or save the report and share it another way.
This report is too large to send. Save it to Downloads and share it another way.
Tap to describe the problem and send it
